prompts.coast: Use case: illustration-story. Create a beautiful refined wide coastal restaurant deck background for an adult literary interactive comic. A quiet first-person seated view on an Oregon Pacific coast cafe terrace. Preserve the established warm ivory, deep pine, muted teal, ochre and restrained vermilion palette and watercolor/gouache, colored-pencil and delicate ink texture. Make it more luminous, spacious and tactile than the reference: soft late-afternoon honey light, air and fine atmospheric depth. Composition precisely: quiet pale sky and subtle low-contrast sea in the LEFT 35 percent so large dark title type can be overlaid there; visible pale blue-green ocean and small natural white surf through the MIDDLE, water clearly between y=35% and y=65%; rocky pine headland on the middle-right horizon; weathered timber railing across y=64–72%; a warmly sunlit empty wooden tabletop filling the lower-right from x=45%, y=73% to the bottom/right edges; dark cafe wall and one glowing small copper wall lamp on the far right; soft pine canopy entering from the top-right with its trunk at the right edge; tiny foxgloves near the right wall. Keep the ocean broad and unoccluded enough to animate its surface. No people, gulls, book, cup, pot or loose objects on the table. NO lettering, title, logo, border or watermark. One full scene, no panels. Cinematic 16:9 landscape. The reference image is style/composition reference, not an edit target; make a fresh coherent illustration.
prompts.props: Use case: illustration-story. Make a genuinely TRANSPARENT sprite atlas for a refined watercolor/gouache, colored-pencil and delicate ink adult literary comic, warm ivory/deep pine/ochre colors. Exactly THREE equal columns and TWO equal rows on a 1536x1024 image, six 512x512 transparent cells. No background paper, no grid, no labels, no lettering, no borders, no watermark. All objects comfortably inside cells with alpha padding. Row0: THREE states of the SAME handsome moss-green cloth-bound book on a wooden table viewed obliquely from seated eye height, spine on the LEFT, front lower/right edge foreshortened consistently: cell0 CLOSED book with blank dark-green cover, ivory page edges and little muted copper spine detail; cell1 HALF OPEN book, front cover raised about45 degrees with blank ivory endpaper exposed; cell2 FULLY OPEN book, two softly curved blank warm ivory pages with gentle center crease and slightly raised outer corner. Same book size/perspective/material and natural paper shadows; no levitating book or detached cover, no printing on any page. Row1: cell3 a lovely ivory ceramic TEACUP ONLY, visible amber tea, curved handle at right, no saucer, no steam, no table; cell4 matching empty ivory SAUCER ONLY from the same viewing angle, cup indentation and soft restrained rim shadow; cell5 a graceful delicate PINE BOUGH with sparse soft needles, stem entering from the RIGHT edge and leafy tips reaching LEFT, intended to pivot gently from its rightmost stem. Objects rendered as coherent painted illustrations, not a diagram and not flat vector icons. All six objects isolated on actual transparent background. Cup and saucer must be separate objects so the cup alone can lift naturally.
